Take turns whenever you like. Open the game from the home page any time to see if it's your move.

How to play

  • On your turn, pick one of three words and draw it. No letters or numbers!
  • Your friend watches your drawing appear line by line and taps letters to guess the word.
  • Guess it and you both score: harder words are worth more. Then the guesser becomes the drawer.
  • Stuck? Tap Skip to see the word and keep the game going. Ten drawings make a game.
